name: AA Block country with redirect
author: AA Extensions

sections.description:
We know many times , people have to redirect their visitor to their respective pages according to their country. In this plugin we keep this option. So that you can easily redirect your visitor to their respective country.

Features

  1. Per-post/CPT toggle
    • Enable/disable blocking per post, page, or CPT
  2. Country code input
    • Comma-separated format (e.g., `US,IN,UK`)
  3. Redirect blocked users
    • Custom URL for redirection
  4. IP geolocation
    • Uses `ip-api.com` for country lookup
  5. Security
    • Nonces for form protection
    • Input sanitization
    • Capability checks
sections.installation:
1. Install as regular WordPress plugin.

  2. Go your plugin setting via WordPress Dashboard and find “AA Block country with redirect” activate it.

  3. Setup country code via settings. It’s like for bangladesh it will be BD, for canada it will be ca
